title: Review: The intramural league
explanation: **Level 2 review!** You run the campus intramural basketball league, and the standings sheet is a mess: a typo, a team entered twice, and no win percentages yet. Tidy it up and make it easy to read. There's nothing new here, just everything from Level 2: shortcuts, editing, Paste Special, number formatting and conditional formatting.

tasks.prompt: Click A1, then jump to the last team at the bottom of the list with a shortcut.
hints: Hold Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) and press the down arrow.
You should land on A9, Bench Mob.

tasks.prompt: A4 says "Hoop Dreems". Edit the cell and fix it to Hoop Dreams.
hints: Click A4 and use the edit-cell keys from Lesson 7, or just retype it.

tasks.prompt: One team was entered twice. Highlight duplicate values in A2:A9 to find it.
hints: Select A2:A9, then use the Duplicate Values rule.
tasks.answer: Select A2:A9 → Conditional Formatting → Duplicate values

tasks.prompt: Delete the second Net Rippers row (row 7): right-click the row number and choose Delete.
hints: Right-click the grey 7 at the far left, then Delete.
Fast Break should move up into row 7.

tasks.prompt: In F2 to F8, work out each team's win percentage: wins ÷ (wins + losses). Write it once, then copy it down.
hints: Excel divides before adding, so you need brackets: =B2/(B2+C2)
Then copy F2 down to F8.
tasks.answer: =B2/(B2+C2) in F2, then copy down to F8

tasks.prompt: Show F2:F8 as percents with 1 decimal place, like 87.5%.
hints: Select F2:F8, click %, then adjust the decimals.

tasks.prompt: Highlight the teams with a win percentage over 60%: a greater-than rule on F2:F8 with the value 0.6.
tasks.teach: Remember, 60% is stored as 0.6, so the rule's value is 0.6.
hints: Select F2:F8, then use the Greater Than rule.
tasks.answer: Select F2:F8 → Conditional Formatting → Greater than 0.6

tasks.prompt: In G2 to G8, work out each team's point difference: points for − points against.
hints: G2 is =D2-E2, then copy it down.
Ballers should be 82 and Bench Mob −112.
tasks.answer: =D2-E2 in G2, then copy down to G8

tasks.prompt: Last one: save this week's win percentages as a snapshot. Copy F2:F8 and use Paste Special → Values into H2:H8.
hints: Copy F2:F8, right-click H2, Paste Special, then Values.
Click H2 afterwards: it should be a number, not a formula.
tasks.answer: Copy F2:F8, right-click H2, Paste Special → Values

recap: Level 2 done! You can move with shortcuts, edit and restructure a sheet, freeze results with Paste Special, format numbers, and highlight what matters with conditional formatting. Next up: sorting, filtering and tables.
